title: Canonical torus chart coactions satisfy the associativity law
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $M$ a fine monoscheme with finite affine cover [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. Let $C$ be a torsion-free connected component of $M$, $L$ the group completion of its generic stalk, $X$ its component open in the toric realization $k[M]$, and $T=\operatorname{Spec}k[L]$, with the group structure $e^l\mapsto e^l\otimes e^l$, $e^l\mapsto1$, $e^l\mapsto e^{-l}$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. Suppose $a:T\times_k X\to X$ is a morphism over $k$ whose restriction to every component affine chart $\operatorname{Spec}k[P]$ is the spectrum of $e^p\mapsto e^{\deg(p)}\otimes e^p$, followed by the chart inclusion. Then $a(gh,x)=a(g,a(h,x))$ as morphisms over $k$, with the canonical unitors and associator of fibre products.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.2.4, printed p.103; explicit chartwise verification and gluing in Step 6 of lem-trf-lattice-torus-coordinates-action.

proof.text: The component chart images cover X. Base change by T twice gives a cover of T times T times X by products with the same charts.

The assumed formula for a factors its restriction through the same chart. On each such chart the composite using torus multiplication sends e^p to e^deg(p) tensor e^deg(p) tensor e^p by the comultiplication formula. Applying the coaction twice gives that identical tensor. Linearity proves equality on all of k[P]. The affine fibre-product comparison identifies the tensor associator with the fibre-product associator.

Both global composites have the calculated restrictions to the product chart cover. Uniqueness of morphisms on an open cover proves their equality. Faithfulness of forgetting Over Spec k gives exactly the asserted equality over the base.

theorem canonicalTorusCoaction_associativity (k : Type u) [Field k] {M : Fine.{u}}
    (C : ToricComponent M)
    (a : ((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⊗
        Over.mk (componentToBase k C) ⟶ Over.mk (componentToBase k C))
    (ha : IsCanonicalTorusAction k C a.left) :
    (μ[((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))] ▷
      Over.mk (componentToBase k C)) ≫ a =
        (α_ ((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
          ((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
          (Over.mk (componentToBase k C))).hom ≫
            ((Spec (.of (MonoidAlgebra k C.lattice))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ◁ a ≫ a
